_documentation.purpose: Brand+model-prefix overrides for products where AIs consistently misclassify due to limited training data on niche/specialty product lines.
_documentation.scope: Applied post-consensus, before title generation. Only override fields explicitly listed per family.
_documentation.matching: Case-insensitive prefix match on raw model number after normalization.

FAB32._note: SMEG FAB32 family is a 60cm two-door retro refrigerator with bottom freezer (11.7-12.8 cu ft). FAB28 is single-door top-freezer style. AIs occasionally misclassify FAB32U color variants (e.g., FAB32UORRN) as Top-Freezer — every other FAB32U variant in the family resolves correctly.

FAB28._note: SMEG FAB28 family is a 60cm single-door retro refrigerator (~10 cu ft) with top freezer compartment.
